answer: Each reward epoch opens a narrow admission gate: to enter, an agent must post a per-identity bond stamped with a unique pigment hash derived from its address; cloned bonds sharing one stamp are rejected at the gate. The flow runs through a canyon to a jetty where every vessel docks alone, pays its own toll, refunded only after the epoch settles. An attacker spawning N puppets must stake N separate, non-transferable bonds in full: capital cost scales one-to-one with no bulk discount, while an honest user posts a single bond once and reclaims it intact.
